gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to remove associations between custom fields and screens to ensure that obsolete fields do not appear in the user interface, thereby streamlining the user experience and maintaining the relevance of the fields displayed.
gold.ideal: Successfully removes the specified associations between the custom fields and screens, returning a 204 No Content status.
